All 8 backend pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_default_pos_shortcuts.py PASS. No backend or frontend bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: pos_settings_routes.py:65-74 — GET /saas/default-pos-shortcuts: when no doc exists, returns {updated_at:null, updated_by:null}. After a PUT with [] (empty list), a doc IS written so updated_at/updated_by become populated even though shortcuts is empty. This means the spec's 'When no defaults exist, returns updated_at=null' is technically only true on a pristine system, never again after the first save. Considered acceptable since the UI always treats null gracefully.

pos_settings_routes.py:52 — save_shortcuts uses `model_dump(exclude_none=False)` so {productId:null,color:null,label:null} entries are persisted. Frontend filters out empty slots before PUT, so this is fine, but a defensive backend filter would harden against future direct API consumers.

SaasAdminPage.js:488 — `while (padded.length < 8) padded.push(...)` always pads on the frontend. This is purely UX; the backend correctly stores only the real (non-empty) saved shortcuts so the contract `count: N` remains accurate. Good separation.
test_wallet_chain.py uses hardcoded localhost:8000 — 18 errors when run from the test runner. NOT in scope for this iteration but should be migrated to BASE_URL env var in a future cleanup pass.
